text:
Nora (partnerships): Quick alert: Support flagged ~120 customers who hit daily entitlements exactly at local-midnight. The Azure metering CSV has a bare date field `usage_day` with no TZ. Can we triage?
Ben (eng): Likely the same local-day vs UTC-day drift. Which fields do we get from Azure?
Nora (partnerships): `account,usage_day,units,sku,region` — no timestamps. Sample:
```
AC-772,2026-12-09,300,REDWOOD-PRO-1,us-west-2
AC-772,2026-12-10,20,REDWOOD-PRO-1,us-west-2
```
Tess (eng-infra): Short-term: add an ingestion transform that attempts to map `usage_day` to UTC using customer timezone (if present) or region->tz heuristic. We'll feature-flag it so we can back out.
Marco (finance): Need comms and a hold workflow before any billing adjustments. Prepare credit memo template.
Nora (partnerships): Action items: Ben -> small PR to normalize date->UTC-day (flagged), Tess -> implement region heuristics + audit log, Marco -> draft billing holder + customer note, I'll ping Azure rep to ask for ISO timestamps.
Ben (eng): PR name `recon/normalize-usage-day-utc`. I'll include a dry-run mode outputting CSV with per-account delta pct. ETA: tomorrow morning.
Tess (eng-infra): I'll add `marketplace_date_normalize` flag and an `audit_recon_shifts` table capturing original and adjusted day plus confidence. Ops can review low-confidence shifts.
Marco (finance): Once dry-run exists, send me the delta CSV. Anything >1% change per account goes to manual review; >5% we pause auto-adjust.
ExportBot (bot): Ticket PRT-2188 created: "azure-usage-day-tz-reconcile" priority P1.
Nora (partnerships): Also request from Azure: include `usage_start_ts`/`usage_end_ts` in future exports or an explicit tz field. That will avoid heuristics.
Ben (eng): Noted. I'll paste the PR and dry-run link here when ready.
Tess (eng-infra): Will schedule dry-run and provide logs.
Nora (partnerships): Thanks team. We'll circle back after dry-run results.
